answer: An agent market grants one active job slot per identity only after it locks 100 credits in escrow for 30 days. Agents onyx, zephyr and trellis each face the same rule, and closing an account does not release its deposit early. An attacker seeking 1,000 fake workers must therefore immobilize 100,000 credits for a month. Creating new names cannot bypass the lock, so flooding the market costs capital and the returns that capital could otherwise earn.
